thread:
marta: :rotating_light: slo-bot fired a 5m SLO burn for api.gateway.request_errors (5xx) — 12% error rate, spike started ~08:12 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts and aborted requests.

slo-bot: ALERT api.gateway.request_errors > 10% for 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. See /dash/slo/api-errors.

ben: seeing support tickets from two mid-market customers saying requests return 502/504 intermittently and client SDK retries lead to double charges. attaching one of their cURL repros (sanitized).

ben: ```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-final","input":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
```

ryan: thanks, will look. initial glance at edge proxy metrics shows a sudden rise in upstream connection resets (RST) and 504s from the proxy -> runtime pool between 08:10-08:20. Could be keepalive / idle conn churn.

aoife: logs i've pulled from loki for that window: query we used:
```
{job="edge-proxy"} |= "upstream reset" | json | line_format "{{.time}} {{.upstream}} {{.error}}"
```
results show a cluster of `connection reset by peer` from edge-nodes in eu-west-1 to runtime-pool-3.

marta: are traces available for those 5xxs? last time we had similar, traces were absent because trace headers were dropped at the proxy.

aoife: partial. about 60% of 5xx requests have trace_id, 40% don't — likely something dropping headers or fast-fail before header propagation. i also see an increase in TLS session renegotiations on the edge in that window.

ryan: we rolled edge-proxy image edge-proxy:1.23.0 ~07:45 UTC in eu-west-1 (config-only deploy). rolling back to 1.22.7 is an option if we see a strong signal.

marta: let's try quick mitigation before rollback — increase proxy idle timeout and upstream keepalive retries to reduce connection churn. can someone stage the change to eu-west-1? @ryan

ryan: on it. planning a config bump:
```yaml
proxy: 
  upstream_keepalive: 60s
  idle_timeout: 90s
  max_retries: 3
```
I'll push to canary edge nodes first (2 nodes) then monitor.

ben: customers still hitting 502s right now (tickets updated). Should we communicate a known issue to affected customers? CC: cs-team.

marta: yes — set public status note: brief summary, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m. make sure not to call it incident yet until we confirm rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Canaries updated: edge-proxy config canary -> edge-canary-2 (eu-west-1).

aoife: after canary change, 5xx rate on canary nodes dropped from ~14% to ~3% in the next 4 minutes. non-canary nodes stayed high. that strongly implicates proxy config defaults or the new image.

ryan: interesting — canary success suggests config tweak helps. i'm going to roll the config to remaining edge nodes in eu-west-1 but hold image version. will watch 2m windows.

marta: add an alert suppression for noisy customer retries so we don't spam the channel while we verify. set suppression for 15m with owner=ryan.

slo-bot: suppression applied for api.gateway.request_errors (15m).

aoife: also noticed that requests that lost trace_id correlate with client keepalive=false header in a subset of SDKs. possible interaction: proxy fast-fails when a connection with no keepalive attempts is reused? need to reproduce locally.

ryan: can someone capture a tcpdump on edge-canary-2 for 30s during repro? i want to confirm TCP resets vs TLS renegotiation.

marta: @aoife can you run tcpdump and upload pcap to the incident bucket. use filter: `host runtime-pool-3` and port 443.

aoife: will do. grabbing pcap now.

aoife: uploaded pcap -> gs://redwood-ops/incident-1867000000/edge-canary-2.pcap

ryan: pcap looks like client connections are being closed with RST from runtime side when concurrent conn > 120. runtime pool autoscaler is healthy but there's a kernel-level per-process fd limit being hit on some older runtime instances.

marta: aha — we recently rolled a subset of runtime instances with new init that left ulimit lower (100k -> 1k) in the base image for older scale groups. that would explain fd exhaustion causing RSTs under load.

ben: so root cause is combo: lower fd limit on some runtime nodes + aggressive proxy keepalive defaults in new image? that would explain why config change helped the canary.

ryan: plan: 1) increase proxy keepalive/idle_timeout globally (already rolling), 2) rollback problematic runtime base image in eu-west-1 ASG or lift ulimit via init script, 3) schedule full runtime pool drain/replace for nodes with low ulimit.

marta: agreed. owners: ryan -> proxy config rollout + runtime rollback plan; aoife -> confirm trace propagation coverage and upload final pcap + logs; ben -> customer comms + ticket updates. i'll own postmortem and SLO remediation (credits).

ben: I've drafted a customer update: "We're seeing intermittent 5xxs due to edge-runtime connection resets in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with root cause and credits if impacted." sending to CS for review.

aoife: FYI observability follow-ups: adding a dashboard tile for 'trace-propagation coverage' (percent of requests with trace_id) and a log-based monitor for `upstream reset` with grouping by upstream instance id.

marta: quick repro steps for the oncall to verify in the lab:
1) run a 100rps load test against canary edge with short keepalive (1s) and concurrent conns 200
2) observe `connection reset by peer` in logs and missing trace header on failed requests
3) capture tcpdump on runtime and inspect rst flags

ryan: i'm going to start runtime rollback for one ASG now (eu-west-1-a). will pause if error increase.

deploy-bot: ASG eu-west-1-a rollback initiated -> target image redwood-runtime:2.18.1

marta: good. let's reconvene in 30m or sooner if 5xx rate spikes. document all timeline entries to the incident doc.

ben: copied timeline to internal incident doc and pinged CS. customers informed.

aoife: post-change checks: trace coverage returned to baseline (~98%), 5xx rates down to 0.8% cluster-wide after full config rollout + one ASG rollback. still watching for residual fd issues.

marta: closing loop — final action items:
- ryan: complete runtime rollbacks or ulimit fix across all older ASGs (owner: ryan)
- aoife: add trace-coverage alert and `upstream reset` monitor (owner: aoife)
- ben: finalize customer credits and close tickets (owner: ben)
- marta: write postmortem and link to timeline (owner: marta)

marta: thanks everyone. great quick detection and rollback. marking channel as resolved but leave incident doc open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
